questionText:

Statement I: The world-renowned 'Chamba Rumal' (embroidered kerchief) was created by court painters drawing outlines on muslin, which were then embroidered by women using silk floss.
Statement II: Chamba Rumals were coarse jute carpets used only as horse blankets in warfare.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Statement I is correct: Pahari court artists drew delicate miniature designs on silk/muslin, which women embroidered using double satin stitch (do-rukha). Statement II is incorrect: they were fine embroidered square kerchiefs used for covering offerings and gifts.
Hence Option C is correct.
